description: It started when I was reading a book about the famous pamphlet Common Sense which aided in the formation of our country. The logic seemed to mesh well with the attitude of Missourians. You see, those of us who were born here take our heritage seriously. It was Congressman Willard Duncan Vandiver who gave us our nickname, The Show Me State. title: Why Missouri Common Sense?
